title: House Plan XKT2 + interactive PBR effects panel
description: Loads HousePlan as XKT2 (the XGF v1.1.0 form — PBR materials, textures, alpha mode/cutoff, normals, UVs). Tries the persistent .xkt2 file first; if missing, round-trips the bundled glTF through the runtime XGFExporter at version 1.1.0 and re-loads the result. The same effects panel as the Sponza/HousePlan-glTF demos exposes IBL, shadows, SAO, tonemap, bloom, AA, edges, and sun direction.
